question: Where are a restaurant located within 160 kilometers distance toward the southwest of Ulrich Wildlife Preserve, Morton, IL?
sql: WITH source_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Ulrich Wildlife Preserve%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Morton%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P, source_location AS SL WHERE P.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, SL.geometry::geography, 160000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(SL.geometry), ST_Centroid(P.geometry))) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
